writers.name: Charles Perrault
writers.level1: The first Item you buy each round costs 1 fewer coin.

writers.level3: 2 VP for each Item. Maximum 14 VP.

writers.name: Brothers Grimm
writers.level1: The first time each round you take a Good or Bad card, gain 1 coin.
writers.level2: Gain 1 XP for each Good–Bad pair you own, maximum 5 XP.
writers.level3: 3 VP for each Good–Bad pair. Maximum 15 VP.

writers.name: Hans Christian Andersen
writers.level1: The first time each round you discard a card or Item, gain 1 XP.

writers.level3: 2 VP for each card with a Game End effect. Maximum 14 VP.

writers.name: Carlo Collodi
writers.level1: Your Action cards with values 1–5 count as +1 when determining turn order.
writers.level2: Return a played Action card to your hand, then discard one card from your hand.

writers.name: Lewis Carroll

writers.level3: 2 VP for each card with Activation. Maximum 14 VP.
